name: Last Call at the Neon Cabinet
description: A high-score arcade cabinet on the lab network has gone quiet, and its latest integrity token is missing from the public board. Scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the token from the cabinet.

tasks.name: Recover the integrity token
tasks.description: The arcade cabinet's latest integrity token has vanished from the public board. On the lab network, scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the token from the cabinet.
hints: The cabinet may answer on an unexpected port. Compare how open services respond instead of trusting their port numbers.
One candidate speaks a familiar naming service protocol. Look at what a zone-wide record transfer can reveal.
Request a full transfer for the arcade's local zone, then inspect its TXT records for the integrity token.
